Allow sound, vibration and banners through DND. Enable these notifications for the app in system settings first.
Not enabled: enable the module in LSPosed and reopen this page
\nTest system hooks after enabling scope and rebooting.

1. Enable this module in LSPosed, select the system framework (system) and System UI (com.android.systemui) scopes, then reboot.

2. Turn on the main switch and select apps. Changes apply to new notifications in about one second. Cloned apps and work profiles are not included automatically.

3. To use this app’s test notification, first add DND Allowlist itself to the allowlist and turn on DND. Start the test and return to the home screen to check sound, vibration and banners. Remove it and test again for comparison. For normal use, add only the apps you want to allow.

The module does not enable disabled or silent channels or raise volume. App internet calls and media playback are outside its scope.
